content.text: I added a shared `logRequest` helper to src/handlers.js and call it from all three handlers (`login`, `updateEmail`, `deleteAccount`), so every request now logs its request ID, handler name, user ID, and response status — enough to trace an incident timeline. Each log line is emitted with the actual outcome, so failed logins (401) are distinguishable from successes. I deliberately excluded `req.body` from the logs because it contains passwords and email addresses, which shouldn't be written to log output.
